title: Getting a Haircut
context: Sam 路过街区的理发店，想不预约直接剪头；发型师 Casey 帮他确认修剪幅度、两侧长度和头顶保留，并说明时长、造型和价格。

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.en: Hi, do you take walk-ins? I'd like a haircut today.
dialogue.zh: 你好，你们接受未预约的客人吗？我想今天剪个头。

dialogue.speaker: Casey
dialogue.en: We do. I have an opening in about ten minutes. What are you looking for?
dialogue.zh: 接受。大概十分钟后有空位。你想剪成什么样？

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.en: Just a trim, please, and maybe a little shorter on the sides.
dialogue.zh: 稍微修剪一下就好，两侧可以再短一点。

dialogue.speaker: Casey
dialogue.en: Sure. How short would you like the sides? I can do a two or a three.
dialogue.zh: 好的。两侧想剪多短？我可以用二号或三号推剪。

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.en: A three, please. And please don't take too much off the top.
dialogue.zh: 请用三号。上面请不要剪掉太多。

dialogue.speaker: Casey
dialogue.en: Got it. I'll keep the length on top and just clean it up. Have a seat over here.
dialogue.zh: 明白了。上面会保留长度，只是修整齐。请坐到这边来。

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.en: Thanks. About how long will the haircut take?
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。这次剪发大概需要多长时间？

dialogue.speaker: Casey
dialogue.en: About twenty-five minutes. Can I get you some water while I set up?
dialogue.zh: 大概二十五分钟。我准备的时候，要不要给你倒杯水？

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.en: I'm all set, thanks. Will you style my hair at the end?
dialogue.zh: 不用了，谢谢。最后会帮我把头发定型吗？

dialogue.speaker: Casey
dialogue.en: Yes. I'll wash, cut, and blow-dry it, so you'll be ready to go.
dialogue.zh: 会的。我会洗、剪，再用吹风机吹干，弄完你就可以直接走。

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.en: Perfect. A little product is fine, too. What's the price for a haircut?
dialogue.zh: 太好了。也可以稍微用一点造型产品。剪发怎么收费？

dialogue.speaker: Casey
dialogue.en: It's thirty-two dollars, plus tax. You can pay at the front when we're done.
dialogue.zh: 三十二美元，另加税费。剪完后到前台付款就行。

expressions.zh: 你们接受未预约直接来的客人吗？到店询问是否需要预约时常用。
expressions.example: Hi, do you take walk-ins? I'd like a haircut today.

expressions.zh: 稍微修剪一下，表示只剪掉一点，不想改发型。
expressions.example: Just a trim, please, and maybe a little shorter on the sides.

expressions.en: don't take too much off the top
expressions.zh: 上面不要剪掉太多，说明头顶想保留长度时常用。
expressions.example: A three, please. And please don't take too much off the top.

expressions.zh: 我不用了 / 我这边没问题，礼貌谢绝对方的额外提议。
expressions.example: I'm all set, thanks. Will you style my hair at the end?

expressions.zh: 另加税费，报价时常用来说明标价还没含税。
expressions.example: It's thirty-two dollars, plus tax. You can pay at the front when we're done.

pronunciation: walk-ins 读作 /ˈwɔːk ɪnz/，重音在 walk；trim 的 tr 要读清楚，读作 /trɪm/；sides 读作 /saɪdz/；blow-dry 读作 /ˈbloʊ draɪ/，两个音节都要咬清楚；thirty-two 里的 th 读作 /θ/，不要读成 /s/。

practice.title: Part 1 · Haircuts
practice.prompt: How often do you get a haircut?
practice.answer: I usually get a haircut every five or six weeks. I like a simple style, so I often ask for a trim and a little shorter on the sides. If the salon is busy, I try to go on a weekday afternoon.

practice.title: Part 2 · Getting a haircut
practice.prompt: Describe an imagined time you got a haircut. Say why you went, what you asked the stylist to do, and how the visit went.
practice.answer: Imagine that I walk into a neighborhood salon without an appointment and ask if they take walk-ins. The stylist has an opening in ten minutes, and I ask for a trim, with the sides a little shorter. I also say I do not want too much taken off the top, and the stylist tells me it will take about twenty-five minutes. At the end, the stylist washes, cuts, and blow-dries my hair, and I pay thirty-two dollars plus tax at the front. 这是入门短答，请补充个人经历并扩展到接近两分钟。

practice.title: Part 3 · Personal style
practice.prompt: Why do some people spend a lot of time and money on their hair?
practice.answer: Hair is often part of how people present themselves at work or in social life, so a good haircut can make them feel more confident. Some styles also need regular maintenance, which costs more time and money. Other people prefer a simple, low-maintenance cut because it is cheaper and easier to look after.

practice.title: 跟读与口头练习
practice.prompt: 先听完整对话，再逐句跟读，再完成口头练习。
practice.answer: 用四到六句在理发店说明你想怎么剪：询问能否不预约直接剪，说明两侧和头顶分别想怎么处理，并问需要多长时间以及价格是否含税。
